definitions.explanation: One of the four bases on a baseball diamond. Used with numbers: {一塁|いちるい} (first base), {二塁|にるい}, {三塁|さんるい}, and {本塁|ほんるい} (home plate).
A small fortification or earthwork. Now mostly found in written and historical contexts and in idioms.

examples.japanese: ⟦{満塁|まんるい}→満塁：31624_manrui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦チャンス→チャンス：03857_chansu⟧だ。

⟦ランナー→ランナー：09483_rannaa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{二塁|にるい}→二塁：32002_nirui⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{一気|いっき}→一気：08891_ikki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{本塁|ほんるい}→本塁：33078_honrui⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{走|はし}って→走る：00519_hashiru⟧、⟦{同点|どうてん}→同点：08586_douten⟧になった。
examples.english: The runner ran all the way from second base to home, tying the score.

examples.japanese: ⟦{城|しろ}→城：03255_shiro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{土|つち}→土：02229_tsuchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{塁|るい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: Earthen ramparts remain around the castle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{敵|てき}→敵：03546_teki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{塁|るい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{迫|せま}る→迫る：03928_semaru⟧⟦{兵|へい}→兵：29510_hei⟧たち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{様子|ようす}→様子：01521_yousu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{絵巻|えまき}→絵巻：14098_emaki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{描|えが}かれている→描く：02013_egaku⟧。
examples.english: The scroll shows soldiers closing in on the enemy fort.

notes:
In everyday Japanese the word is met almost only in baseball, usually inside compounds.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{一塁|いちるい}→一塁：32193_ichirui⟧ / ⟦{二塁|にるい}→二塁：32002_nirui⟧ / ⟦{三塁|さんるい}→三塁：31673_sanrui⟧: first / second / third base
- ⟦{本塁|ほんるい}→本塁：33078_honrui⟧: home plate; ⟦{本塁打|ほんるいだ}→本塁打：24569_honruida⟧: home run
- ⟦{満塁|まんるい}→満塁：31624_manrui⟧: bases loaded
- ⟦{盗塁|とうるい}→盗塁：31887_tourui⟧: stolen base

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {塁|るい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{摩|ま}する: to rival, to be nearly as good as (a written idiom, literally to brush the enemy's fort)
